description: Post an update on a status page incident (investigating, identified, update, monitoring, resolved). Public, and sent to subscribers unless notify_subscribers is false.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the text is written in. Defaults to the language of the incident title.

message.description: Public text of the update, shown on the status page and sent to subscribers. Basic HTML allowed.

notify_subscribers.description: Email/SMS/Slack/Teams the status page subscribers. Default true.

status.description: Stage this update moves the incident to. "update" keeps the current stage. Any stage but "resolved" reopens a resolved incident.

name: add_status_page_incident_update
title: Post status page incident update
